info.name: Shopify Admin REST About Queries API
Shopify Searches For Customers That Match A Supplied Query

params.name: order
params.description:
Set the field and direction by which to order results.
                  (default: last_order_date DESC)

params.name: query
params.description: Text to search for in the shop's customer data.

params.name: limit
params.description:
The maximum number of results to show.
                  (default: 50, maximum: 250)

params.name: fields
params.description: Show only certain fields, specified by a comma-separated list of field names.
